statement: A project key is one or more characters, uppercase ASCII letters and digits only, starting with a letter. It is the immutable prefix of every ticket key and of every ticket directory name, so the project validator and the ticket-path validator enforce the same rule.
lengthIsNotPartOfTheGrammar: An existing project keeps whatever key length it was created with, so neither validator caps length. The creation surfaces cap a new key at creationMaxLength for readability, and key derivation produces at most derivationMaxLength characters.
